purpose: H09AAPPLE-73 empirical OCR vs vision comparison fixtures
scoring: Case passes OCR if all ocr_expected_contains tokens appear in normalized OCR text. Vision passes if any vision_expected_contains_any token appears in normalized model answer. Icon-only OCR is expected to fail (empty/wrong) - scored separately.
hardware_note: Record host machine specs in results/run-meta.json

cases.notes: Step-2 vision case; Step-1 OCR should not invent a confident label
OCR should pick up text; vision should also name the control
Baseline easy case for both OCR and vision
